purpose: Teach: 見捨て/テック/送り出し/王家/シリアル/樽/鍛える/野心

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前を、絶対、見捨てないからね、桜、約束、本当に、これは、絶対だよ、リク、信じてね、本気で。
lines.en: Riku, I'm never going to abandon you. I promise you that — I really mean it. You have to believe me.
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath the surface. Slow, deliberate pacing on the promise. Her voice steadies as she commits to each word. Warm but unmissable — this matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、テック企業で、本気で、頑張ってるって、お母さんから、聞いたよ、桜、お前のお父さんも、すごいよな、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. Your dad works at a tech company and he really gives it everything. Your mom told me that. Sakura, that's impressive — seriously.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. A beat of genuine respect on the compliment. Soft but not uncertain — he's thinking through what he's saying as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 学校、卒業生の送り出しの式、本気で、感動するよね、リク、お前、覚えてる?私、本気で、泣いちゃったよ、本当に、感動した、絶対。
lines.en: The graduation ceremony at school — it really got to me. Remember that, Riku? I actually cried. I was so moved.
lines.style: Wistful, a little distant in memory. Voice softens on the word 'cried.' Slight smile underneath — not sad, just tender. Trails off gently as if lost in the moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 王家のドラマ、最近、面白いの、出てきてさ、桜、お前も、見てみたら?お父さん、お母さんと、一緒に、楽しめるよ、絶対。
lines.en: There's a new period drama that's been really good lately. You should check it out, Sakura. You could watch it with your parents — you'd probably all enjoy it together.
lines.style: Casual suggestion with a gentle lift at the end. Conversational, not pushing. A small smile in his voice — he's thinking of her watching it with her family.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 朝食、私、シリアル、最近、ハマってるのよ、リク、お前は、何、食べてる?気になるよ、本当に、教えてくれる?
lines.en: I've been really into cereal for breakfast lately. What about you, Riku? I'm curious what you've been eating. Will you tell me?
lines.style: Bright, curious energy. Quick pace, almost playful. The question rises slightly at the end — genuine interest, not performing it. Warm and open.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、ワイン樽の歴史、扱ったぞ、桜、お前、興味、出てきた?結構、深いんだぜ、本気で、絶対、勉強したくなるよ、本気で。
lines.en: We covered wine barrel history in home economics. Did that spark anything for you, Sakura? It's actually really deep — studying it makes you want to know more.
lines.style: Animated, slight surprise in his own enthusiasm. The explanation builds in energy. A small laugh underneath — he didn't expect to be this excited about it either.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近、本気で、体を、鍛えるのに、頑張ってるよね、本当に、すごいよ、私、誇りに、思ってるよ、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: You've been working so hard on getting in shape lately. That's impressive, Riku. I'm really proud of you — I mean that.
lines.style: Warm approval, genuine and specific. Voice brightens on the compliment. Steady eye-contact level — she's not overstating it, but she's not hiding it either.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の野心、本気で、応援するからな、桜、絶対に、お前なら、できるよ、信じてる、本気で、これは、絶対だぞ、絶対。
lines.en: I believe in your ambitions, Sakura. I really do. If anyone can do this, it's you. I mean it — I'm rooting for you, completely.
lines.style: Firmer now, conviction settling in. The 'I believe' lands with quiet weight. Not overwhelming — steady, like a promise. Slight warmth on her name. Finishing strong.
